metadata.short_desc: Suno music generation and same-task audio retrieval through Ace Data Cloud.
metadata.desc: Suno music generation and same-task audio retrieval through Ace Data Cloud. Configure your own Ace API key. /suno_ace shows help; administrators use /suno_ace_task for an existing task. This integration is provided by Ace Data Cloud.

api_key.description: Ace Data Cloud API Key for Suno
api_key.hint: Copy/create a dedicated key in Ace Applications → General application → Manage Keys. Allow /suno/audios and /suno/tasks. No Bearer prefix; never paste into chat. Masking does not encrypt the data directory.
